title: Telegram bridge access.json (HIMMEL-2176 Task 6)
description: Formal shape check for the telegram bridge's access.json, mirroring scripts/telegram/gate.ts's Access/GroupPolicy types exactly. Deliberately permissive at every object boundary (additionalProperties: true at the top level and per-group) -- known fields are type-checked; an unrecognized field (e.g. the fork's own 'pending' key, see gate.ts's module comment) is left alone rather than rejected. probes.js's probeTelegramAccess (scripts/himmelctl/lib/probes.js) consumes this via a small hand-rolled validator (this repo is zero-dep by convention); a future gate-layer consumer can import this same file directly.
